youtube.cookiesDescription: Upload a cookies.txt file to access age-restricted or member-only YouTube content. You can export cookies from your browser using extensions like Get cookies.txt LOCALLY (Chrome/Firefox).
youtube.limitsDescription: Cap YouTube and Apple Music playlist imports (stream register or download). For large playlists (e.g. 250+ tracks), raise the import cap below (max 500).
youtube.streamDirectlyDescription: Video streams play straight from YouTube instead of being downloaded first: they start at once whatever their length, and live broadcasts work. Leave off if streams fail to start with this on; YouTube refuses direct playback from some networks.
youtube.maxVideoDurationHint: Applies to downloaded videos; not used when YouTube videos are streamed directly.

customCss.safeUiTitle: Safe UI mode is active for this page load
customCss.safeUiDescription: Stored custom CSS is not applied. Disable or Reset below, then reload without ?safe-ui=1 to use custom CSS again. Safe mode does not erase your saved CSS.
customCss.description1: Custom CSS is stored only in this browser. It is injected after application styles when enabled, and only inside the signed-in management UI.
customCss.description2: Custom CSS can hide controls, override accessibility, and cause the browser to request external resources via constructs such as @import and url(...). There is no sanitizer — treat pasted/imported CSS as trusted local customization.
customCss.recoveryHint: Before enabling, copy a recovery URL you can type if the UI becomes unusable: {{path}}
customCss.editorHint: Typing and importing update the draft only. Save commits; Enable applies the saved text.
customCss.resetDescription: This disables custom CSS and permanently clears the saved text in this browser. Base theme, accent, background, and motion preferences are kept.
customCss.sizeError: Custom CSS must be {{limit}} or smaller (UTF-8). Current size: {{size}}.
customCss.sizeErrorShort: Custom CSS must be {{limit}} or smaller (UTF-8).
customCss.safeUiEnableBlocked: Safe UI mode is active. Reload without ?safe-ui=1 before enabling custom CSS.
customCss.importedDraft: Imported into the editor draft — Save to commit
